title: Area 51 crash: either secret US testing or intelligence watching nuclear tests
summary: Ralph Larson tells of Area 51 crash: either secret US testing or intelligence watching nuclear tests, about 1940s-1950s at Nevada test site and Area 51, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

plain: A man named Ralph Larson, on an episode where he is presented as a former CIA chief, talks about a crash said to be linked to Area 51, a secret US military test site in the Nevada desert. Picking up an idea from the host, Jesse Michels, and admitting he has not researched it himself, he says it was either secret American testing or some intelligence watching the nuclear bomb tests nearby in the 1940s and 50s.
